name: Guilin & Yangshuo
about: Spring and fall (Mar–May, Sep–Nov) bring the clearest views of the karst peaks; summer (Jun–Aug) is hot, humid, and rainier, with October's Golden Week holiday bringing the year's biggest domestic-tourism crowds.
overview: The karst limestone peaks that appear on China's 20-yuan banknote, a scenic river cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo, and some of Asia's best rock climbing and countryside cycling.
costOverview: Genuinely cheap for the scenery on offer — countryside bike rentals and simple riverside meals cost next to nothing; the Li River cruise is the one real splurge.

specialSeasons.text: China's Golden Week holiday (Oct 1-7) brings a huge spike in domestic tourism and crowds.
